name: DefDensity_t
notes: Target max defect density. Used in P_quality (sub-indicator defect density). ≤ target scores 100%.

name: Escaped_t
notes: Target max escaped defects. Used in P_quality (sub-indicator escaped rate). ≤ target scores 100%.

name: MTTR_t
notes: Target mean time to recover (hours). Used in P_quality (sub-indicator MTTR). ≤ target scores 100%.

name: SPI_t
notes: Target schedule performance index. Used in P_time (sub-indicator SPI). Optional, default 1 = on track.

name: CPI_t
notes: Target cost performance index. Used in P_cost (sub-indicator CPI). Optional, default 1 = on budget.

name: LT_t
notes: Target maximum lead time. Used in P_flow (sub-indicator Lead Time)

name: WIP_max
notes: Max recommended Work In Progress items. Used in P_flow (sub-indicator WIP breaches). TBI.

name: CFR_max
notes: Deprecated. Previously used in Change Failure Rate.

name: ROI_t
notes: ROI target. Used in P_value (sub-indicator ROI).

name: IaC_t
notes: Target coverage for Infrastructure as Code. Used in P_engineering (sub-indicator IaC coverage).

name: HighVuln_t
notes: Target max high-severity vulnerabilities open >30 days (0 = strict compliance)

name: CritRisk_t
notes: Target max overdue critical risks at closure (0 = none tolerated)

name: GovExc_t
notes: Max tolerated exceptions. If < 2 score will always be 0 when there are excceptions

name: PR_noReview_t
notes: Target percentage of pull requests with no reviewer (min. 1 to 50)

name: W_mttr
notes: MTTR  in P_quality (Mean Time To Resolution)

name: W_q_storyrev
notes: Stories without a reviewer in P_qauality

name: W_q_pr
notes: Pull request review ratio in P_quality

name: W_sat_pm
notes: PM estimation of client satisfaction  in P_satisfaction

name: W_eng_iac
notes: IaC coverage in P_engineering (Infrastructure as Code)
